name: bitfilters
description: Probabilistic set-membership filters as DuckDB columns. Quotient, XOR (8/16-bit), Binary Fuse (8/16-bit), Parquet-compatible split block Bloom, and DuckDB-style Bloom filters — answer 'is X in this set?' in O(1) using a fraction of the memory of the source set, with tunable false-positive rates and zero false negatives. Build them from values of any type.

cta.title: Skip Expensive Operations Probabilistically
cta.description: Install Bitfilters to materialize compact, fast set-membership filters as DuckDB blobs. Pre-filter joins, dodge cache misses, skip data partitions — all with measurable false-positive bounds.

quickStart.title: Build an xor8 filter from a column
quickStart.sql:
-- ~0.39% false-positive rate, ~9 bits per key
WITH f AS (
  SELECT xor8_filter(email) AS filter FROM users
)
SELECT email,
       xor8_filter_contains(f.filter, email) AS might_be_known
FROM new_signups, f
LIMIT 10;

quickStart.title: Per-partition Quotient filters that size themselves
quickStart.sql:
-- r = 8 remainder bits, ~0.4% false-positive rate; q is picked for you
SELECT bucket,
       quotient_filter(8, id) AS filter
FROM ids
GROUP BY bucket;

quickStart.title: Parquet-compatible Bloom filter
quickStart.sql:
-- Sized for 1,000 distinct values at a 1% false-positive rate
SELECT bloom_filter(1000, 0.01, key) AS filter FROM keys;
